<h2>Resolve the Shared Spatial MEM Construction Strategy</h2>

<h3>Description</h3>

<p>Validates shared Moran eigenvector construction settings and resolves
'&quot;auto&quot;' to the exact or fast implementation using only the number of
input spatial locations.
</p>


<h3>Usage</h3>

<pre><code class='language-R'>resolve_spatial_mev_strategy(
  strategy = NULL,
  n_locations = NULL,
  n_mev = NULL,
  exact_max_locations = NULL,
  fast_eigenvectors = NULL
)
</code></pre>


<h3>Arguments</h3>

<table role = "presentation">
<tr><td><code id="strategy">strategy</code></td>
<td>
<p>Character scalar. One of '&quot;exact&quot;', '&quot;fast&quot;', or '&quot;auto&quot;'.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="n_locations">n_locations</code></td>
<td>
<p>Positive integer giving the number of input spatial locations.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="n_mev">n_mev</code></td>
<td>
<p>Positive integer giving the number of public Moran eigenvectors requested.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="exact_max_locations">exact_max_locations</code></td>
<td>
<p>Positive integer giving the largest input allowed to use dense exact
construction.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="fast_eigenvectors">fast_eigenvectors</code></td>
<td>
<p>Positive integer giving the low-rank basis size for fast construction. It
must be at least 'n_mev'.</p>
</td></tr>
</table>


<h3>Value</h3>

<p>Named list containing the requested and selected strategies, strategy
version, validated counts, and shared exact/fast settings.
</p>


<h3>Examples</h3>

<pre><code class='language-R'>resolve_spatial_mev_strategy(
  strategy = "auto",
  n_locations = 2000L,
  n_mev = 3L,
  exact_max_locations = 1999L,
  fast_eigenvectors = 200L
)
</code></pre>
